Container.Name: Proposarr
Container.Overview:
Proposarr proposes new movies and series for Radarr and Sonarr, ranked by Claude against your Plex or Jellyfin watch history. Every pick explains which titles in your library it relates to, and every add asks which quality profile to use.
After installing, open the web UI and connect Radarr, Sonarr, Plex or Jellyfin, TMDB and Claude there; no other container settings are required. Radarr and Sonarr API keys are optional when they allow local access without login.
Claude access: a Claude subscription token (run `claude setup-token` on any computer) or an Anthropic API key.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, encrypted settings, library cache and Claude CLI state.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the appdata folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Web login username
Config.Description: Optional. With a password, the web UI and API require this login.

Config.Name: Web login password
Config.Description: Optional. Set together with the username.

Config.Name: Claude subscription token
Config.Description: Optional; normally entered in the web UI. Setting it here locks the field in the UI. Use this or an Anthropic API key, not both.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts API keys saved in the web UI; generated in the appdata folder when empty.
